👤 Sabiway API Documentation - Profiles

Endpoints for managing user profiles and follow system.

Retrieve a list of all profiles.

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 1,
    "username": "johndoe",
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "followers_count": 10,
    "following_count": 5,
    "posts_count": 3
  }
]

Retrieve the currently logged-in user’s profile.

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "full_name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3
}

Retrieve a single profile by ID.

Response:
{
  "user_id": 2,
  "username": "janedoe",
  "full_name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "followers_count": 15,
  "following_count": 7,
  "posts_count": 6
}

Update your own profile details.

Request Body:
{
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe"
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com"
}

Partially update your own profile. Only send the fields you want to change. 

Request Body:
{
  "whatsapp_number": "+2348012345678"
}

Response:
{
  "user_id": 1,
  "username": "johndoe",
  "full_name": "Johnny Doe",
  "email": "john@example.com",
  "whatsapp_number": "+2348012345678",
  "followers_count": 10,
  "following_count": 5,
  "posts_count": 3
}

Delete your own profile (irreversible).

Response:
{
  "message": "Profile deleted successfully"
}

Follow another user.

Response:
{
  "message": "You are now following janedoe"
}

Unfollow a user you are currently following.

Response:
{
  "message": "You have unfollowed janedoe"
}
